readings.title: The Second Tablets
readings.subtitle: Mercy and the Ark
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 10:1] At that time <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Hew for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to <dn>Me</dn> on the mountain, and you shall make yourself an ark of wood.</dq> [2] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> write on the tablets the Words that were on the first tablets, which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.’</dq> [3] So I made an ark of acacia wood, hewed two tablets of stone like the first, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hand. [4] And <dn>He</dn> wrote on the tablets according to the first writing, the Ten Words which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had spoken to you in the mountain from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gave them to me. [5] Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made. And there they are, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded me. [6] And the children of Yisra’ĕl set out from the wells of the sons of Ya‘aqan to Mosĕrah. There Aharon died, and there he was buried. And El‘azar his son served as priest in his place. [7] From there they set out to Guḏgoḏah, and from Guḏgoḏah to Yotḇathah, a land of rivers of water. [8] At that time <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> separated the tribe of Lĕwi to bear the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to serve <dn>Him</dn> and to bless in <dn>His</dn> Name, as it is today. [9] Therefore Lĕwi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is his inheritance, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> promised him. [10] And I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty nights, as at the first time. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> listened to me at that time also, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> would not destroy you. [11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Arise, begin the journey before the people, and let them go in and possess the land which <dn>I</dn> swore to their fathers to give them.’</dq>

readings.title: The Requirement of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Walking in His Ways
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 10:12] And now, Yisra’ĕl, what is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> asking of you, but to fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, to walk in all <dn>His</dn> ways and to love <dn>Him</dn>, and to serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> with all your heart and with all your being, [13] to guard the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and <dn>His</dn> laws which I command you today for your good? [14] See, the heavens and the heaven of heavens belong to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, also the earth with all that is in it. [15] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> delighted only in your fathers, to love them. And <dn>He</dn> chose their seed after them, you above all peoples, as it is today. [16] And you shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and stiffen your neck no more. [17] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn> of mighty ones and <dn>Master</dn> of masters, the great <dn>Ěl</dn>, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality nor takes a bribe. [18] <dn>He</dn> executes right-ruling for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the stranger, giving him food and a garment. [19] And you shall love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Mitsrayim. [20] Fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, serve <dn>Him</dn>, and cling to <dn>Him</dn>, and swear by <dn>His</dn> Name. [21] <dn>He</dn> is your praise, and <dn>He</dn> is your <dn>Elohim</dn>, who has done for you these great and awesome deeds which your eyes have seen. [22] Your fathers went down to Mitsrayim with seventy beings, and now <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has made you as the stars of the heavens for numbers. [Deuteronomy 11:1] And you shall love <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and guard <dn>His</dn> charge, and <dn>His</dn> laws, and <dn>His</dn> right-rulings, and <dn>His</dn> commands, always. [2] And you shall know today – for it is not your children who have not known and who have not seen the discipline of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>His</dn> greatness, <dn>His</dn> strong hand and <dn>His</dn> outstretched arm, [3] and <dn>His</dn> signs and <dn>His</dn> works which <dn>He</dn> did in the midst of Mitsrayim, to Pharaoh sovereign of Mitsrayim, and to all his land; [4] and what <dn>He</dn> did to the army of Mitsrayim, to their horses and their chariots, when <dn>He</dn> made the water of the Sea of Reeds overflow them as they pursued you, and how <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has destroyed them to this day; [5] and what <dn>He</dn> did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place; [6] and what <dn>He</dn> did to Dathan and Aḇiram the sons of Eliyaḇ, son of Reḇu’ĕn, how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the living beings that were at their feet, in the midst of all Yisra’ĕl. [7] For your eyes have seen all the great works of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> which <dn>He</dn> did.

readings.title: A Land of Rain and Care
readings.subtitle: Contrast with the Land of Egypt
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 11:8] And you shall guard all the commands which I command you today, so that you are strong, and shall go in and possess the land which you are passing over to possess, [9] and to prolong your days in the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> swore to give to your fathers and their seed, a land flowing with milk and honey. [10] For the land which you are going in to possess is not like the land of Mitsrayim from which you have come, where you sowed your seed and watered it by foot, as a vegetable garden, [11] but the land which you are passing over to possess is a land of hills and valleys, which drinks water from the rain of the heavens, [12] a land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> looks after, the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year. [13] And it shall be, if you diligently obey <dq><dn>My</dn> commands which I command you today, to love <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> and to serve <dn>Him</dn> with all your heart and with all your being,</dq> [14] <dq>then <dn>I</dn> shall give you the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, and you shall gather in your grain, and your new wine, and your oil.</dq> [15] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be satisfied.</dq> [16] Guard yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other mighty ones and bow down to them, [17] and the displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burn against you, and <dn>He</dn> shut up the heavens and there be no rain, and the land not yield its fruit, and you quickly perish from the good land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is giving you. [18] And you shall lay up these Words of <dn>Mine</dn> in your heart and in your being, and shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes. [19] And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up. [20] And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates, [21] so that your days and the days of your children are increased on the soil of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens on the earth. [22] For if you diligently guard all these commands which I command you, to do them, to love <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, to walk in all <dn>His</dn> ways, and to cling to <dn>Him</dn>, [23] then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves. [24] Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness, and Leḇanon, from the river, the River Pherat, even to the Western Sea is your border. [25] No man shall stand against you. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> shall put the dread of you and the fear of you upon all the land where you tread, as <dn>He</dn> has spoken to you.

readings.title: The Choice Set Before You
readings.subtitle: The Blessing and the Curse
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 11:26] See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse: [27] the blessing, when you obey the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> which I command you today; [28] and the curse, if you do not obey the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, but turn aside from the way which I command you today, to go after other mighty ones which you have not known. [29] And it shall be, when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has brought you into the land which you go to possess, that you shall put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ěḇal. [30] Are they not beyond the Yardĕn, toward the setting sun, in the land of the Kena‘anites who dwell in the desert plain opposite Gilgal, beside the terebinth trees of Morĕh? [31] For you are passing over the Yardĕn to go in to possess the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it. [32] And you shall guard to do all the laws and right-rulings which I am setting before you today.

readings.title: The Chosen Place of Worship
readings.subtitle: A Pure Sanctuary
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 12:1] These are the laws and right-rulings which you guard to do in the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of your fathers is giving you to possess, all the days that you live on the soil. [2] Completely destroy all the places where the nations which you are dispossessing served their mighty ones, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree. [3] And you shall break down their altars, and smash their pillars, and burn their Asherim with fire. And you shall cut down the carved images of their mighty ones and shall destroy their name out of that place. [4] Do not do so to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, [5] but seek the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses out of all your tribes, to put <dn>His</dn> Name there, for <dn>His</dn> dwelling, and there you shall go. [6] And there you shall take your burnt offerings, and your slaughterings, and your tithes, and the contributions of your hand, and your vowed offerings, and your voluntary offerings, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock. [7] And there you shall eat before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has blessed you. [8] Do not do as we are doing here today – each one doing whatever is right in his own eyes. [9] For you have not yet come to the rest and the inheritance which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you. [10] But you shall pass over the Yardĕn and shall dwell in the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you to inherit, and <dn>He</dn> shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and you shall dwell in safety. [11] And it shall be, that the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses to make <dn>His</dn> Name dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, and your slaughterings, and your tithes, and the contributions of your hand, and all your choice vowed offerings which you vow to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [12] And you shall rejoice before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, you and your sons and your daughters, and your male and female servants, and the Lĕwite who is within your gates, since he has no portion nor inheritance with you. [13] Guard yourself lest you offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see, [14] except in the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

readings.title: Sacred Consumption
readings.subtitle: Laws Concerning Meat and Blood
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 12:15] Only, whatever your being desires you shall slaughter and eat meat, according to the blessing of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> which <dn>He</dn> has given you, within all your gates. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer. [16] Only, the blood you do not eat, pour it on the earth like water. [17] You are not allowed to eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstlings of your herd or of your flock, or any of your offerings which you vow, or your voluntary offerings, or the contribution of your hand. [18] But you shall eat them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> in the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses, you and your son and your daughter, and your male servant and your female servant, and the Lĕwite who is within your gates. And you shall rejoice before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> in all that you put your hand to. [19] Guard yourself lest you forsake the Lĕwite all your days on your land. [20] When <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> expands your border as <dn>He</dn> has promised you, and you say, ‘Let me eat meat,’ because you desire to eat meat, eat as much meat as your being desires. [21] When the place where <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses to put <dn>His</dn> Name is far from you, then you shall slaughter from your herd and from your flock which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given you, as I have commanded you, and you shall eat within your gates as much as your being desires. [22] Only, as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you eat it. The unclean and the clean alike eat of it. [23] Only, be strong not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, do not eat the life with the meat. [24] Do not eat it, pour it on the earth like water. [25] Do not eat it, that it might be well with you and your children after you, when you do what is right in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [26] Only, your set-apart offerings which you have, and your vowed offerings, you shall take up and go to the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chooses. [27] And you shall render your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the altar of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>. And the blood of your slaughterings is poured out on the altar of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and you eat the meat. [28] Guard and obey all these words which I command you, that it might be well with you and your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>. [29] When <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> cuts off from before you the nations which you go to dispossess, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land, [30] guard yourself lest you be ensnared to follow them, after they are destroyed from before you, and lest you inquire after their mighty ones, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their mighty ones? And let me do likewise.’ [31] Do not do so to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dq>, for every abomination which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> hates they have done to their mighty ones, for they even burn their sons and daughters in the fire to their mighty ones. [32] All the words I am commanding you, guard to do it – do not add to it nor take away from it.
